_README: Single source of truth for affiliate/partner links. server.js serves /go/<slug> (302 → target+ref, logs a click) and scripts/generate-seo-pages.mjs renders disclosed CTA blocks that link to /go/<slug> with rel='sponsored nofollow'. To activate an earner: sign up, paste your code into `ref`, set active:true, rebuild. Links work (unattributed) even before you add a code, so nothing is ever a dead link. NEVER commit a real code you consider secret — these are public by nature, but treat them as config, not source.
disclosure: Some links below are partner links: if you sign up or buy through them, LandingPrep may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you. We only list services we'd genuinely point a student to, and it never changes what you pay. LandingPrep's own tools and notes are, and always will be, 100% free.

wise.name: Wise (formerly TransferWise)
wise.blurb: Mid-market exchange rate with transparent fees — usually far cheaper than a bank for tuition and living-cost transfers abroad.
wise.howToJoin: Referral link: Wise app → Invite friends. Or join Wise's affiliate programme (via Partnerize) for publisher payouts.

bookmyforex.name: BookMyForex
bookmyforex.blurb: India-based forex + international student remittance; live rates for outward tuition transfers and forex cards.
bookmyforex.howToJoin: BookMyForex has an affiliate/refer-and-earn programme — self-serve signup on their site.

airalo.name: Airalo
airalo.blurb: Data eSIM for the day you land — no roaming bill, no hunting for a local SIM at the airport.
airalo.howToJoin: Airalo affiliate programme is self-serve via the Impact network — no traffic minimum to apply.

amazon-gre.name: GRE prep books on Amazon
amazon-gre.blurb: The official ETS guide and top-rated practice books — a search, so it stays current as new editions publish.
amazon-gre.howToJoin: Amazon Associates (India): instant self-serve signup, no human approval. Put your store tag in `ref`. Note: you must make 3 qualifying sales within 180 days to stay in the programme.

amazon-gmat.name: GMAT prep books on Amazon
amazon-gmat.blurb: Official GMAC guides and quant/verbal practice sets for the Focus Edition.
amazon-gmat.howToJoin: Same Amazon Associates tag as amazon-gre.

gyandhan.name: GyanDhan (education loans)
gyandhan.blurb: Free education-loan eligibility check + comparison across lenders for study abroad.
gyandhan.howToJoin: Requires a lead-partner/referral agreement (they pay per disbursed loan). Apply via GyanDhan partnerships — NOT a click-through affiliate. Keep inactive until the agreement is signed.

prodigy.name: Prodigy Finance (no-cosigner loans)
prodigy.blurb: Collateral-free, no-cosigner loans for international Master's students at select universities.
prodigy.howToJoin: Prodigy has a refer-a-friend/ambassador programme; publisher payouts need their partner agreement. Keep inactive until confirmed.
